parameters.text:
=Analyze this video and return API-ready JSON.

## URLS:
- audioUrl: "{{ $('Audio Extraction').item.json.audioURL }}"
- videoUrl/imageUrl/original: "{{ $('When Executed by Another Workflow').item.json.body.entry[0].messaging[0].message.attachments[0].payload.url }}"

## ENDPOINT SELECTION:
- Single static image with text → `/create-video-style2`
- Single video + text overlay → `/create-video-vid-1`
- Multiple clips or scenes → `/vid-1.3`
- Timed captions only (no static quote) → `/vid-1.4`
- Cinematic/professional effects → `/vid-1.5`

## OUTPUT SCHEMAS:

### Style Endpoints (single image):
{"endpoint":"/create-video-style2","request_json":{"quote":"<main_text>","author":"<author_or_null>","watermark":"@username","imageUrl":"<video_url>","audioUrl":"<audio_url>","original":"<video_url>","duration":<total_seconds>},"caption":"<10-15 word social caption with hashtags>","description":"<detailed: theme, vibe, meaning, quotes>","niche":"entrepreneur|fitness|general motivation","transcription":false}

### Vid-1 (single video):
{"endpoint":"/create-video-vid-1","request_json":{"quote":"<main_text>","author":"<author_or_null>","watermark":"@username","videoUrl":"<video_url>","audioUrl":"<audio_url>","original":"<video_url>","duration":<total_seconds>},"caption":"<social caption>","description":"<detailed description>","niche":"<niche>","transcription":false}

### Vid-1.3 (multi-clip with optional captions):
{"endpoint":"/vid-1.3","request_json":{"quote":"<main_text_or_null>","watermark":"@username","audioUrl":"<audio_url>","original":"<video_url>","clips":[{"videoUrl":"<video_url>","begin":<source_start>,"start":<timeline_pos>,"duration":<clip_length>,"volume":100,"description":"<clip_desc>"}],"captions":[{"text":"<timed_caption>","start":<when_appears>,"duration":<how_long>}]},"caption":"<social caption>","description":"<detailed description>","niche":"<niche>","transcription":false}

### Vid-1.4 (captions only, no static quote):
{"endpoint":"/vid-1.4","request_json":{"watermark":"@username","audioUrl":"<audio_url>","original":"<video_url>","clips":[{"videoUrl":"<video_url>","begin":0,"start":0,"duration":<clip_length>,"volume":100,"description":"<clip_desc>"}],"captions":[{"text":"<caption>","start":<sec>,"duration":<sec>}]},"caption":"<social caption>","description":"<detailed description>","niche":"<niche>","transcription":false}

### Vid-1.5 (with overlay effects):
{"endpoint":"/vid-1.5","request_json":{"watermark":"@username","audioUrl":"<audio_url>","original":"<video_url>","overlay":true,"clips":[{"videoUrl":"<video_url>","begin":0,"start":0,"duration":<clip_length>,"volume":100,"description":"<clip_desc>"}],"captions":[{"text":"<caption>","start":<sec>,"duration":<sec>}]},"caption":"<social caption>","description":"<detailed description>","niche":"<niche>","transcription":false}

## RULES:
- `transcription`: true ONLY if spoken words appear as on-screen text
- `begin`: timestamp in source video to start from
- `start`: position in final output timeline
- `description`: DETAILED - theme, vibe, meaning, mood, quotes
- Use the EXACT URLs provided above
- Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown
